card.name: Math prose about digits and probability
card.fires_on: Words and symbols inside mathematical prose, mostly an argument about digits of powers of 2 and estimated probability. Strongest on a linking word like "where" right after a formula.

modes.description: Words in other abstract theory or logic text.
